title: London-based Payhawk, which offers enterprise expense and procurement management tools, raised a $280M Series C led by Goldman Sachs at a $2B valuation (Yazhou Sun/Bloomberg)
summary: Yazhou Sun / Bloomberg: London-based Payhawk, which offers enterprise expense and procurement management tools, raised a $280M Series C led by Goldman Sachs at a $2B valuation — Payhawk, a fintech startup that helps businesses manage expenses, has raised fresh financing led by the growth equity arm …
